tei:div.tei:p: "!#'um̐ḥ bla ma drag po rta khyung 'bar ba lasaḥ klu'i gdon 'grol 'og gdon mthar byed bzhugasaḥ

bla ma drag po gnyen po gsum ldan la na maḥ rta khyung 'bar ba'i sgo nas klu'i gdon 'grol zab mo la sbyor dngos rjes gsum lasaḥ dang po niḥ stegs gtsang mar bum gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmaḥ 'bru tshom gyi khar las bum bcud ldan dngaḥ bdag bum gnyis 'thus kyi sman gtor rak+ta nyer spyod dang bcas pa bshamaḥ ci bde bar 'byung po rnams gnas la chags pas dogs gnas kyi sa bkram pa'i steng ne'u sing klu shing bra ma la sogs pas bskor ba'i nang khongs pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su klu gzugs thal sbyar sbrul mjug canaḥ mgo sbrul gyi gdengs kas mtshan pa dngaḥ 'dab ma brgyad la gdon gzugs sbrul 'khyil pa'i rnam pa can re bkodaḥ klu gzugs kyi steng lcug ma'i khri'u'i khar rdza bum 'o chab kyis bkang bar klu sman dngaḥ dkar gsum mngar gsum btab pa bzhagaḥ ne'u sing gi phyogs mtshams su klu gtor sbrul dkris brgyad dngaḥ klu nor nyer gcig sogs mthun pa'i yas rdzas bkodaḥ logs gcig tu nad pa'i glud dkor cha rgyas pa dngaḥ 'o cholaḥ chab gtoraḥ snas skud nag poḥ rma bya'i mdongs dang glag gi sgro sogs 'du bya'oḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun lasaḥ dang po bdag bskyedaḥ rta khyung 'bar ba'i las gzhung bsrangs la bzlas pa'i tshe klu dbang du bsdu ba dang gzir gnan gyi dmigs pa la gnad du bsnun noḥ gnyis pa las bum sgrub pa niḥ bsang sbyangaḥ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i nang du chu srin nya sbrul la sogs pa gdon gzugs 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan la pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du pheḥnag po las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byasaḥ yongs su gyur pa lasaḥ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal khro bo'i rgyal po nā ga rak+sha sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag pa la dbu dgu srin zhal khros pa'i nyams can sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka dgus brjid pa'i sbrul mgo dbus ma la rin po che'i prog zhus mtshan pa phyag bco brgyad na gri gug dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa'i rtsa phyag gnyis thugs kar steng 'og dngaḥ

gzhan rnams gdengs stabs 'jigs pa'i sku la khro bo'i rgyan thams cad rdzogs pa'i spyi bor oṃḥ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangasaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sa gnyis med bstimaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar dang sarba pañca bha liṃ ta khā hi sa mchodaḥ sku mchog khros pa srin po'i gdongaḥ klu gnyan sa bdag 'dar zhing skragaḥ bdud rnams kun gyi bdud chen poḥ khyod la skyabs mchi phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bzlas dmigs niḥ snying rje khros pa'i drag shul gyisaḥ klu gdon gdug pa tshar gcod phyiraḥ thugs kar 'jam dpal zhi ba bsgomaḥ srin zhal rnams nas sngags kyi sgraḥ me stag yar ba lta bu yisaḥ log 'dren gnod byed tshar gcad gyuraḥ oṃ phe lang hūm̐ḥ zhes bzla gal te klu gdon stobs che zhing rang nyid gnyen po stobs kyi lha gyad du gyur pa yin naḥ nag po ti pa tsa ya nā ga rā tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces bzla ba'i gnad ma shes na drag sngags thub chod du bgrangs pas rang srog gcod pa mthong ngoḥ 'jam drag gang bzla yangaḥ sham buraḥ oṃ nā ga du na tsan+dhe tsen+dhe mi li mi li bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni sarba bi ṣa ta ra phaṭaḥ ces 'dogs stong tsho las mi nyung bar bzlas rjesaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul nas bum lha 'od zhu bya'oḥ gsum pa klu bum sgrub cing klu dgug pa niḥ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du ne'u sing dang ljon shing me tog bkra ba'i skyed mos tshal gyi nang du 'dzam bu'i gling gi klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad 'khod pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la 'od snang las grub pa'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang 'o chab dang klu sman gyis gang ba'i steng na sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog sngon po mgrin pa yan chad dkar po la phyag gnyis thugs kar klu thams cad ngan song las sgrol ba'i phyag rgya can gsal ba las 'od zer dwangs shing bsil bar 'phros pas klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin rang dbang med par bkug nas gzugs brnyan dang 'dresaḥ

rang rang gi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsalaḥ sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas bum pa gang zhing klu gso ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam laḥ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te nā ga shwa ra rā dza ya nā ga sarba durga te shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hāḥ ci nus bzlas rjes klu la bde ba sbyin pa'i gzungasaḥ tad+ya thāḥ dhā ra ṇiḥ dhā ra ṇiḥ ud+dhā ra ṇiḥ saṃ pra tiṣ+ṭhi teḥ bi dza ya brnaḥsat+yaḥ pra ti gnya' sa ra haḥ gnyan na pa tiḥ ud pa dha niḥ bi nā ma niḥ a bhi she tsa niḥ a bhi bya hā raḥ shu bhā ba tiḥ a dzī ma dhuḥ e hi kuṃ pā la naḥ ba ha ha ra kle shā naḥ dhu na pā paṃḥ sho dhā yaḥ margā naḥni rā hi kaḥ dharmā ta shud+dhaḥ lo ka bi ti ma riḥ rā dza sa du khaḥsha ma naḥ sarba bud+dha a wa lo ka naḥ a dhiṣ+ṭhi teḥ prad nya gnya' na bhe swā hāḥ ci rigs brjod nas bum lha 'od zhu bya'oḥ bzhi pa klu dang 'khon sbyong zhing lus sems gso ba niḥ gtor yas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gamaḥ bsdu na nam mkha' mdzod kyis brlabaḥ rang nyid jo bo kha sar+pa ṇir bskyedaḥ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pasaḥ hrīḥ nga ni spyan ras gzigs dbang yinaḥ khyod ni 'byung po rang rgyud canaḥ byol song gdug pa klu yi rigasaḥ 'byung ba kun la gnas bcas shingaḥ rgyal rigs rang bzhin 'jam pa dngaḥ legs nyes stangs 'dzin rje bram rigasaḥ gnod pa'i bdag nyid dmangs gdol sogasaḥ gtso bo nor rgyas dung skyong dngaḥ 'jog po pad+ma pad+ma cheḥ rigs ldan mtha' yas stobs rgyu dngaḥ nam mkhar gnas pa'i gnyan gyi rigasaḥ sa la dbang byed sa bdag sogasaḥ khyo shug mdza' gcugs bran khol kunaḥ zhi ba'i sems kyis da tshur spyonaḥ deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag laḥ khyod rnams 'khon gcugs sbyang ba'i phyiraḥ gnas rten longs spyod skyed mos tshalaḥ dkar gsum mngar gsum 'o chol dngaḥ gtor tshogs rtsi sman rgya mtshos brnganaḥ rmongs dang 'dod pa'i dbang gyur pasaḥ sa gnyan brkos dang brag gnyan gshagasaḥ

shing gnyan bcad dang chu gnyan dkrugasaḥ ri gnyan dkrogs dang gnas rten bshigaḥ thab gzhob 'khon dang grib la sogasaḥ mdor na snod kyi 'jig rten kunaḥ khyod dang ma 'brel gang yang medaḥ de dag kun la phog thug dngaḥ nongs pa gang bgyis mthol lo bshagasaḥ bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrolaḥ bsdams pa glod la mnan pa thegasaḥ mthong reg kha rlangs dug la sogasaḥ rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su sdusaḥ las dang rkyen las klu rnams kyiḥ dbang po yan lag nyams pa dngaḥ mkha' lding me dang bye tshan dngaḥ rig sngags gnod pa mtha' dag kunaḥ byang chub sems dang rten 'brel rdzasaḥ sngags kyi nus pas sos gyur cigaḥ ces brjod la klu bum nas klu rten rnams la 'thor zhingaḥ sam+bha ra bdun re'i mtharaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan dngaḥ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya bstan laḥ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phu swā hāḥ zhes bdun brjodaḥ de ltar gyer sngags sbrel ba ci nus byaḥ do gal che na bag phye la klu sman btab pa'i sho gcig dngaḥ nad pa'i dri ma bsres pa'i sho bcos la nad pa ma rgyal bar du gso chog bskyar roḥ lnga pa dam tshig bsgrag pa niḥ hrīḥ nga ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigasaḥ sems can kun la bu ltar byamasaḥ snying rje chen po'i bdag nyid yinaḥ sems can thams cad pha dang maḥ mdza' bshes ma gyur gcig kyang medaḥ dge ba las ni mtho ris dngaḥ sdig pa las ni ngan song byungaḥ de phyir pha mar gnod byed naḥ de 'dra'i 'bras bu su yis bzodaḥ deng gi rgyu sbyor che ge mo saḥ khyod la phog thug byung ba kunaḥ tshig gis bkrol la brngan gyis bcalaḥ sha mkhon med par byas zin nasaḥ da dung gnod sems mi gtong naḥ rgyal ba'i bka' la mi nyan zhingaḥ las dang rgyu 'bras khyad bsad pasaḥ klu srin khros nas snying khrag 'thungaḥ gso ba'i sman kyang dug tu 'gyuraḥ rig sngags drag po'i me char 'bebaḥ bya khyung nag po'i khrag thabs gtongaḥ de bas dam las ma 'da' b.raḥ

zhi ba'i sems kyis gnas par gyisaḥ zhes brjod gdon dang nad pa gnyis ka la snying rje chen po bsgoms pas phan pa che 'oḥ drug pa dug dbyung ba niḥ snas skud nag pos nad pa'i rkang mtheb dang klu gzugs sbrelaḥ bdag nyid rta khyung 'bar ba'i bskyed rim gsal bas las bum gyi chus nad pa bkru zhing nad gdon thams cad dri lam nas thon te nad rang bzhin med par yalaḥ gdon gzugs brnyan rnams kyis blangs par bsam nasaḥ hūm̐ḥ nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ rta skad rngam sgras stong gsum g.yoḥ khyung gi tsha tshwas log 'dren bsregaḥ 'byung ba chen po rnam bzhi niḥ lus can kun gyi rten yin teḥ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nadaḥ gdon rnams kun gyi nyer len yinaḥ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dngaḥ khro rgyal chen po'i byin rlabs kyisaḥ klu gnyan sa bdag gdug pa'i gdonaḥ rang dbang med par phyir phyungs shigaḥ nad kyi rgyu ni ma rig paḥ rig pa ye shes sman chen gyisaḥ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nadaḥ rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su yalaḥ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ phaṭaḥ oṃ phe lang hūm̐ nā ga du na tsan+dhe tsan+dhe mi li mi li bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni sarba bi ṣa tā ra phaṭaḥ ces pa brgya stong ji tsam nus pas bkru zhing khong du midaḥ de nas rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus na zla gdan la phe lang hūm̐ gsal ba'i 'od zer gyis nad thams cad rlung dang rnag khrag chu seraḥ klu gdon thams cad sbrul nagaḥ gnyan rnams sdig paḥ sa bdag sbal lcongaḥ gdon phra mo rnams ku rtsi'i rnam par 'thon nas gdon gzugs rnams la thim par bsamaḥ byab cingaḥ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po gnyen po stobs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal loḥ bsgrub bya che ge mo la rnam par gyur pa'i nad rlung dngaḥ mkhris pa dngaḥ bad kan dngaḥ ldan 'dus la sogs pa'i nad kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hāḥ khyad par du kun brtags gdon gyi nad dngaḥ

gzhan dbang rkyen gyi nad dngaḥ yongs grub tshe'i nad dngaḥ sngon las 'bras bu'i nad la sogs pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rigs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hāḥ gdon gyi rigs su gyur paḥ lha'i gdon dngaḥ lha ma yin gyi gdon dngaḥ rlung lha'i gdon dngaḥ nam mkha' lding gi gdon dngaḥ dri za'i gdon dngaḥ mi'am ci'i gdon dngaḥ lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dngaḥ gnod sbyin gyi gdon dngaḥ srin po'i gdon dngaḥ yi dwags kyi gdon dngaḥ sha za'i gdon dngaḥ 'byung po'i gdon dngaḥ grul bum gyi gdon dngaḥ srul po'i gdon dngaḥ lus srul po'i gdon dngaḥ skem byed kyi gdon dngaḥ smyo byed kyi gdon dngaḥ brjed byed kyi gdon dngaḥ dri za'i gdon dngaḥ gnon po'i gdon dngaḥ mkha' 'gro'i gdon dngaḥ grib gnon gyi gdon dngaḥ nam gru'i gdon dngaḥ gshin rje'i gdon dngaḥ bya'i gdon dngaḥ ma mo dga' byed kyi gdon dngaḥ kun tu 'gro ba'i gdon dngaḥ tsher ma dang re lde 'don pa la sogasaḥ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu'i byad dngaḥ gdon dngaḥ rigs sngags dngaḥ gnod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hāḥ mdangs dang gzi byin la sogs pa kha zas rnam pa sna tshogs bza' zhing srog 'phrog pa la dga' ba'i gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hāḥ khyad par du zha rengs 'khums gsum dngaḥ mdze shu phol 'bras g.ya' za g.yan pa la sogs pa'i bdag po gza' klu sa bdag rje blon gnyan rgod la sogs pa'i dug thams cad phyir phyungs shigaḥ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ phaṭaḥ oṃ phe lang hūm̐ nā ga du na tsan+dhe tsan+dhe mi li mi li bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni sa kra sarba swā hāḥ klu rgyal rigs kyi dug thams cad phyir phyungs shigaḥ klu rje rigs kyi dug thams cad phyir phyungs shigaḥ klu bram ze'i rigs kyi dug thams cad phyir phyungs shigaḥ klu dmangs rigs kyi dug thams cad phyir phyungs shigaḥ klu gdol pa'i rigs kyi dug thams cad phyir phyungs shigaḥ
